facts.tagline: A scratch-made brunch restaurant in NoPa that makes its own bagels, butter and thick-cut bacon.

facts.siteNote: A 6% surcharge to offset local ordinances is added to the bill. The granola, ETRBLT and All-Star are weekdays only. They keep the bar and window counter for walk-ins; reservations are on OpenTable.

glenn: 27 Oct 9:34 pm: Instagram and site screenshots, 'https://www.earlytorisesf.com/', 'San Francisco • Eats / BEASTY • Breakfast/Brunch'.
flags: Name: their site says 'Early to Rise'; Instagram shows 'Early to Rise Brunch' and Google 'Early To Rise, Scratch Made Brunch'. Used the site's.
Pinot Grigio: the menu prints $10 (tap) and a stray 'G $9'; used $10.
Bottle Service ($48, or $130 with Pierre Gimonnet Champagne) is listed under Mimosa with no description; kept as printed.
Toast ordering shows earlier cutoffs (about 1:15pm weekdays, 2:15pm Sunday); those are order times, not opening hours.
Yelp blocked fetching (403), so Yelp hours were not cross-checked; site, Instagram, OpenTable and AAA agree.
Logo is the 400px Linktree avatar; the site's own rooster favicon is only 48px and its header logo is a wordmark.
